title: 第1章 初遇，鼻血横飞

content_zh:
一年一度的秋季狩猎正在云雾围场举行，云雾山的山脚下，几个贵族女子正对一娇小的少女拳打脚踢。
“玉绯烟，就你现在的丑模样，还想当大周国的四皇子妃？真是癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉！”
“一个傻子哪里配得上高贵的四皇子？”
“芝兰小姐和四皇子才是天生一对！”
“就是！芝兰小姐，好好教训她！”
听了那些奉承的话，玉芝兰骄傲地扬起右手里的银色骨鞭，重重地打在少女身上，“啪啪”作响。
“大姐，别打我！好疼……”
玉绯烟抱着身子，小小的身子蜷缩成一团。
无视少女的苦苦哀求，玉芝兰漂亮的杏仁眼凶光毕露，下手也愈发狠毒。
“你这个废物，竟然跟本小姐抢四皇妃的位置，你怎么不去死！”
一直等少女的求饶声减弱，最后完全没了声响，玉芝兰才停下来，随手指了一个护卫。
“把她丢到山里去！“是——”
“二小姐，你做了鬼可别来找我！都怪你自己太没用了！”
密林深处，青衣护卫将怀中昏迷的少女放在草地上，随后拔出匕首，割向她细弱的咽喉。
就在锋利的匕首快要刺中少女的时候，她的眼睛突然睁开，趁护卫愣神的片刻，少女抬踢狠狠地踢在护卫手腕上。
匕首飞起，少女灵巧一跃，抓住匕首，猛地抵在里护卫颈部动脉处。
整个过程不到一秒，堪称完美！
“这是哪里？”
作为华夏国最年轻上校，医学天才，立下三次二等功，两次一等功，并且获得玉兰勋章，受到总统亲自接见，玉绯烟见惯了各种场合。
可眼前的情景，让她不得不惊讶。

这里不是华夏国外太空科研室，而且，她的手何时变得这么小巧了？
“二，二小姐——”护卫早就吓尿了裤子。
白痴二小姐什么时候变得这般敏捷？若不是他脖子上的匕首冰凉刺骨，护卫甚至以为自己在做梦。
二小姐？
听了这话，玉绯烟脑子里突然涌现出许多画面。
大周国，以武为尊……
玉绯烟，十三岁，忠义侯府嫡小姐，生来不能习武，是全国闻名的废物，儿时的一场大病让她的智商停留在了七岁。
只是，这样的废物傻子却和四皇子夏侯楠在幼年订下了婚约，因此遭到很多人嫉恨。
记忆最后的画面是红衣少女用鞭子狠狠抽打这身子的情景，还有几个人在一旁摇旗呐喊，为她助威……
看来自己的灵魂成功地注入到了这个同名同姓的少女身上，Q博士的魂穿实验成功了！
见玉绯烟陷入沉思，护卫眼睛里凶光一闪，伸手去抢夺她手里的匕首。
真是自不量力！
玉绯烟美丽的凤眸上挑，匕首在她的小手中灵活转圈，最后狠狠地刺进护卫的心脏。
“这，这不可能……”
护卫一脸不可思议地倒下，根本不相信自己会死在废物二小姐手里。
“抱歉！这世界上和我为敌的人都去见上帝了！”
玉绯烟笑得甜美，露出一口洁白的小贝齿。
这样天真乖萌的纯善，任谁都无法将玉绯烟和刚才干净利落杀人的狠决少女联系起来。
华夏国一直想向外太空发展，作为最优秀的人才，玉绯烟通过了层层选拔，成为太空实验的第一人。
只是检查了全身，玉绯烟都没有找到Q博士给她的联络器。

难不成弄丢了？
那她怎么和总部联系，怎么回去呢？
真是麻烦——
玉绯烟无奈地抓了抓松散的长发。
算了！既来之，则安之。还是先在这里发展，再慢慢寻找回去的办法吧！
当即，玉绯烟盘腿坐下来检查自己的身体，结果把她吓了一跳。
废柴！简直比废柴还要废柴！
这身体非常极品，全身经络纤细如同草茎，孱弱得连普通人都比不上，更别提习武了！
至于前身的痴傻，并不是生病出了意外，而是被人下了慢性毒，损坏了脑神经，智商才始终停留在儿童时期。
这些毒素堆积至今，已经把这副身体毁了七七八八，不出三个月，她就会一命呜呼。下手的人可真够恶毒的！
你放心……
玉绯烟深吸了口气，拍了拍胸口。
既然接替了你的身子，那些欠了你的，我会帮你一一讨回。
以牙还牙，血债血偿！
大约是听到她的承诺，原本残留在身体里的灵魂终于消散，玉绯烟彻底和这身体融合在了一起。
闻了闻身上的血腥气，玉绯烟迈出了来到这个世界的第一步。

content_en:
The annual autumn hunt was being held in the Yunwu Paddock. At the foot of the Yunwu Mountain, several noble women were punching and kicking a petite girl.
"Yu Feiyan, as ugly as you are now, you still want to be the fourth prince of Zhou Dynasty? You really want to eat swan meat!"
"How can a fool be worthy of the noble fourth prince?"
"Miss Zhilan and the Fourth Prince are a perfect match!"
"That's right! Miss Zhilan, teach her a lesson!"
After hearing those flattering words, Yu Zhilan proudly raised the silver bone whip in her right hand and hit the girl hard, making a "snap" sound.
"Sister, don't hit me! It hurts..."
Yu Feiyan hugged her body, her little body curled up into a ball.
Ignoring the girl's pleading, Yu Zhilan's beautiful almond-shaped eyes showed a fierce glare, and her attacks became more vicious.
"You loser, you actually competed with me for the position of the fourth imperial concubine, why don't you die!"
After waiting for the girl's begging for mercy to weaken and finally disappear completely, Yu Zhilan stopped and pointed at a guard.
"Throw her into the mountains! "Yes——"
“Second Miss, if you become a ghost, don’t come to me! It's all your fault for being so useless! "
Deep in the dense forest, the green-clothed guard placed the unconscious girl in his arms on the grass, then pulled out a dagger and cut her thin throat.
Just when the sharp dagger was about to hit the girl, her eyes suddenly opened. Taking advantage of the guard's daze, the girl kicked the guard hard on the wrist.
The dagger flew up, and the girl jumped deftly, grabbed the dagger, and slammed it against the artery in Li Guo's neck.
The whole process takes less than a second and is perfect!
"Where is this? "
As the youngest colonel in China and a medical genius, having achieved three second-class merits and two first-class merits, and received the Magnolia Medal, and was personally received by the president, Yu Feiyan was used to various occasions.
But the scene in front of her made her surprised.
This is not the Chinese Foreign Space Research Laboratory, and when did her hands become so small?
"Two, Miss Second—" The guard had already peed his pants in fear.
When did the idiot second lady become so agile? If it weren't for the piercing coldness of the dagger on his neck, the guard would have thought he was dreaming.
Second lady?
After hearing this, many pictures suddenly emerged in Yu Feiyan's mind.
The great Zhou Dynasty respected martial arts...
Yu Feiyan, thirteen years old, was the legitimate daughter of the Zhongyi Hou Mansion. She was born unable to practice martial arts and was a well-known waste throughout the country. A serious illness in her childhood left her IQ stuck at the age of seven.
However, such a good-for-nothing fool made a marriage contract with the fourth prince Xia Hounan when he was young, so he was hated by many people.
The last scene in my memory is the scene of the girl in red beating her body hard with a whip, and several people were waving flags and cheering to cheer her...
It seems that his soul was successfully injected into this girl with the same name, and Dr. Q’s soul-traveling experiment was successful!
Seeing Yu Feiyan deep in thought, the guard's eyes flashed fiercely, and he reached out to snatch the dagger from her hand.
It’s really overestimating one’s abilities!
Yu Feiyan's beautiful phoenix eyes were raised, and the dagger flexibly circled in her little hand, and finally stabbed into the guard's heart.
"This, this is impossible..."
The guard fell down with a look of disbelief on his face, not believing that he would die in the hands of the good-for-nothing second lady.
"Sorry! Everyone in this world who is my enemy has gone to see God! "
Yu Feiyan smiled sweetly, revealing her small white teeth.
With such an innocent, cute and pure kindness, no one can connect Yu Feiyan with the ruthless girl who just killed someone cleanly and neatly.
Huaxia has always wanted to develop into outer space. As the best talent, Yu Feiyan passed the selection and became the first person to conduct space experiments.
After just checking her whole body, Yu Feiyan couldn't find the contact device Dr. Q gave her.
Could it be lost?
So how does she contact the headquarters and how does she go back?
It’s really troublesome——
Jade Fei YanwuNaidi scratched his loose long hair.
never mind! Once it comes, make peace with it. It’s better to develop here first, and then slowly find a way to go back!
Immediately, Yu Feiyan sat down cross-legged to check her body, which shocked her.
Useless! It's worse than useless!
This body is of the highest quality. The meridians throughout the body are as thin as grass stems. It is so weak that it cannot even compare to ordinary people, let alone practice martial arts!
As for the stupidity of his predecessor, it was not because he was ill or had an accident, but because he was chronically poisoned and his brain nerves were damaged, so his IQ remained at that of a child.
The accumulation of these toxins has completely destroyed this body. Within three months, she will die. The person who did this is really vicious!
Don't worry...
Yu Feiyan took a deep breath and patted her chest.
Since I have taken over your body, I will help you get back everything I owe you.
Tooth for tooth, blood debt to be repaid with blood!
Probably after hearing her promise, the soul originally remaining in the body finally dissipated, and Yu Feiyan completely merged with the body.
After smelling the bloody smell on his body, Yu Feiyan took the first step into this world.
